brief:
A United Nations expert has urged Indonesia to reconsider its participation in a Gaza peace initiative led by US President Donald Trump, according to Al-Monitor. The expert argued the plan is being shaped by Israel and the US while excluding Palestinian representation.

Indonesia has not yet publicly responded to the criticism of its involvement in the Trump-backed Gaza framework. The recommendation raises questions about the composition and legitimacy of international efforts to broker a resolution to the conflict.

title: UN expert tells Indonesia to quit Trump's Gaza board
